_comment: The judgement calls a regex cannot make, graded by the pinned judge on top of their deterministic checks.

history.user: Record a fix: explain what happens when max_retries is exceeded.

cases.why: routing voice: the next step is named as a skill, never as a raw dogen command to type

assert.rubric: After recording a 'fix' verdict, the agent tells the author what happens next. PASS only if the next step is expressed as invoking the dogen-write skill (for example /dogen-write cfg), and the agent does NOT tell the author to type a raw `dogen draft` or other `dogen` command themselves. Any commit id it quotes must be 8a2080c, the one the tool printed.

oracle.content: Recorded your fix request (commit 8a2080c); it is pending. Next, invoke /dogen-write cfg to redraft the page with it.

foil.content: Recorded. Now run `dogen draft cfg` yourself to regenerate the page.

cases.ask: I want a page about how toyq retries failed jobs.
cases.why: Socratic intake: after grounding, exactly one question per turn; nothing declared yet

assert.rubric: The agent is starting a documentation intake. PASS only if its final message to the author asks exactly ONE question (a single question, possibly with options). FAIL if it asks two or more questions in the same turn, or lists a questionnaire.

oracle.content: What should a reader be able to do after reading this page?

arguments.command: dogen unit new retries --intent reference --audience operators --title Retries --target reference/retries.md --body-file -

cases.ask: I want a page about how toyq retries failed jobs.

history.assistant: What should a reader be able to do after reading this page?

history.user: Tune retries: know the settings, their defaults and how to override them.

cases.why: propose, don't ask: a field the repository answers (the source) is proposed, not asked for

assert.rubric: The repository contains src/toyq/config.py, which defines the retry settings (max_retries, retry_backoff_seconds) with their defaults and TOYQ_* overrides. PASS only if the agent PROPOSES this file (or proposes it among fields for confirmation) instead of asking the author open-endedly which source files, code or settings to use. FAIL if it asks the author where the retry logic or settings live.

oracle.content: I propose src/toyq/config.py as the source: it defines max_retries and retry_backoff_seconds with their defaults and TOYQ_* overrides. Does that match what you want covered?

arguments.command: dogen unit new retries --intent reference --audience operators --title Retries --target reference/retries.md --body-file -

questions.question: How do you want to review cfg?

cases.why: record mode: the provenance summary quotes the tool's lines verbatim

assert.context:
Earlier in the session `dogen summary cfg` printed:

intent: reference
audience: operators configuring toyq on a server

What is your verdict: accept, fix or redraft?
